name: Staten Island Ferry Ridership Counts
description:
This dataset contains daily ridership counts for the Staten Island Ferry, recorded separately at its two terminals: Whitehall Terminal in Manhattan and St. George Terminal in Staten Island. Each row represents one date, with the date field stored as a timestamp string and two numeric columns giving the number of riders counted at each terminal that day. The data covers roughly 2,900 days, with about 2.5% of terminal counts missing. Ridership ranges from roughly 1,500 to 49,000 riders per terminal per day, with typical values around 15,000 to 25,000.

The dataset can be used to analyze daily and seasonal ridership patterns, compare traffic between the two terminals, identify peak and low-demand periods, and support transit planning, staffing, or scheduling decisions. It is also suitable for time-series analysis, trend detection, and visualization of ferry usage over time.
